gameplay.title: Gameplay
gameplay.objectiveDesc: Run as far as possible while avoiding enemies and collecting power-ups. Your distance traveled is your score.
gameplay.enemiesDesc: Samurais appear every 50m and shoot shurikens. Shoot 3 times to defeat them. Ninjas and bosses appear at higher distances.
gameplay.powerUpsDesc: Collect power-ups to enhance your abilities: shield, infinite ammo, jump boost, slow motion, and multi-shot.
gameplay.scoringDesc: Your score is based on distance traveled. The further you go, the higher your score. Power-ups help you survive longer.
gameplay.tipsDesc: Use power-ups strategically. The shield protects you from collisions, infinite ammo lets you shoot without limits, and jump boost helps you avoid obstacles.

tips.title: Pro Tips
tips.tip1: Use the shield power-up when you see multiple enemies ahead. It will protect you from collisions and give you time to react.
tips.tip2: Infinite ammo is perfect for boss battles. Save it for when you encounter tougher enemies that require more shots to defeat.
tips.tip3: Jump boost helps you avoid ground obstacles and reach higher platforms. Use it strategically to navigate difficult terrain.
tips.tip4: Slow motion is great for precise timing. Use it when you need to make accurate jumps or shots through tight spaces.
